security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan TLB.scala:179-195, the pointer masking ignore transformation (sign-extend for VA, zero-extend for PA based on PMLEN7/PMLEN16) is gated solely on prevmEnable/pres2xlateEnable. When mstatus.MXR=1 and pointer masking is enabled for the effective privilege mode, the TLB incorrectly applies the ignore transformation to the explicit load address. The spec mandates pm_mxr_exception: MXR-in-effect accesses must bypass pointer masking entirely.
security_spec.summary: MXR active + PM enabled: TLB incorrectly masks upper address bits on explicit loads, bypassing MXR X→R translation semantics and enabling tagged-pointer privilege escalation
